info.name: Cascadia Proxy
info.description:
OpenAI-compatible requests against a Cascadia proxy.

Setup (once):
1. Import this collection AND the `cascadia-dev` environment file next to it.
2. Select the `cascadia-dev` environment (top-right in Postman).
3. Paste your proxy bearer token into the environment's `bearerToken` variable.
   Get it from Railway: cascadia-proxy service -> Variables -> CASCADIA_PROXY_BEARER_TOKEN.
4. Send 'Chat completion (cascade)'.

The `/policy` and `/config` requests are public (no auth) and are handy for confirming which cascade is live before sending paid traffic.

request.description: The core cascade call. `model: "auto"` lets Cascadia pick the cheap tier first and escalate to the expensive tier only when its confidence is below the cluster threshold. Uses the collection's bearer auth ({{bearerToken}}). The response carries an `x-cascadia-request-id` header you can correlate in the dashboard.
Streaming requests (stream:true) intentionally skip escalation by design - mid-loop escalation would diverge into incoherent state. Included so you can see the bypass behavior.
Public, no auth. Returns the live cluster table (models, thresholds, shadow rates). Use it to confirm which cascade is deployed before sending paid traffic.
Public, no auth. Non-secret deployment config (data-residency posture, bearer-auth-enabled flag, policy version + cluster count).
